item.title: Blackstone's ZO Skin Health bet could now be worth $2 billion
item.description: The skincare brand avoided celebrity endorsements and Sephora, growing through dermatologists' offices and med spas.

item.title: Trump has traded more stocks than all of Congress combined
item.description: The White House says the president's 28,700 trades are automated and hands-off.

item.title: Tyson Foods pilot shows scale of US child food-access gap
item.description: A $150,000 pilot drew $600,000 in requests from schools in two states, offering lessons on responding to unmet need.

item.title: Better.com founder and interim successor in battle for control
item.description: A dispute between a former CEO and his interim replacement has grown into a struggle for control of the mortgage company Better.com.
